units.source_text: 且说朱雀院自从行幸六条院之后，身体一直不好，而且病得比往常厉害。

en.t: Now, ever since his visit to Rokujo-in, Suzaku-in had been in poor health, and his illness was worse than usual.

units.source_text: 他本来是多病的，但此次特别忧伤。

en.t: He had always been prone to illness, but this time he was especially weighed down by sorrow.

units.source_text: 年来常怀出家奉佛之志，此时此心更加深切了。

en.t: For years he had often longed to renounce the world and serve the Buddha, and now that desire grew still stronger.

units.source_text: 以前只因弘徽殿母后在世，不免多所顾虑，故此志至今未遂。

en.t: Formerly, because his mother, the Empress of Kokiden, was still alive, he had many concerns, and so this wish had remained unfulfilled until now.

units.source_text: 如今母后已经逝世，朱雀院便对人言道：“还是让我皈依佛法吧，我自觉此身在世不久了。”

en.t: Now that his mother had passed away, Suzaku-in said to those around him, "Let me take refuge in the Buddhist law; I feel that this body will not remain in the world much longer."

units.source_text: 就考虑出家前应有种种事宜。

en.t: He therefore began considering the many matters that had to be settled before he entered the religious life.

units.source_text: 子女除皇太子而外，尚有公主四人。

en.t: Among his children, besides the Crown Prince, there were also four princesses.

units.source_text: 其中三公主之母是藤壶女御。

en.t: Among them, the mother of the Third Princess was the Fujitsubo Consort.

units.source_text: 这藤壶女御是桐壶院前代的先帝所生，先帝赐姓源氏。

en.t: This Fujitsubo Consort was a daughter of the late emperor who had preceded Kiritsubo-in, and that emperor had bestowed on her the Genji surname.

units.source_text: 朱雀院当皇太子时，她早已入侍。

en.t: When Suzaku-in was still Crown Prince, she had already entered his service at court.

units.source_text: 原定由她当皇后的。

en.t: She had originally been intended to become empress.

units.source_text: 但先帝早崩，她失去了有力的保护人；再则她的母亲身份不高，只是一个寻常的更衣，因此她住在宫中很不得志。

en.t: But the former emperor died early, and she lost a powerful protector; moreover, her mother's rank was not high, being only that of an ordinary Koi, so her life in the palace brought her little satisfaction.

units.source_text: 加之弘徽殿母后把妹妹胧月夜送进宫来当了尚侍，这尚侍声势盛大，无人能与并肩，藤壶女御就全被压倒。

en.t: In addition, the Empress Mother of Kokiden sent her younger sister Oborozukiyo into the palace to become Naishi no Kami; this lady's influence was so great that no one could rival her, and the Fujitsubo Consort was completely overshadowed.

units.source_text: 朱雀院心中很可怜她，但不久他自己也就让位，无法照拂，徒唤奈何。

en.t: Suzaku-in pitied her deeply in his heart, but before long he himself abdicated, and being unable to care for her, could only lament helplessly.

units.source_text: 因此藤壶女御抱恨在心，郁悒而死。

en.t: For that reason, the Fujitsubo Consort died with resentment in her heart, sunk in melancholy.

units.source_text: 她所生的三公主，最为朱雀院所怜惜。

en.t: The Third Princess, whom she had borne, was the child Suzaku-in pitied most tenderly.

units.source_text: 在许多子女之中，朱雀院最宠爱这三公主。

en.t: Among his many children, Suzaku-in loved this Third Princess best of all.

units.source_text: 此时三公主年仅十三四岁。

en.t: At this time the Third Princess was only thirteen or fourteen years old.

units.source_text: 朱雀院想道：“我即将抛弃红尘，入山修道。

en.t: Suzaku-in thought, "I am about to leave the dust of the world behind and enter the mountains to practice the Way.

units.source_text: 让这女儿独自留在这里，教她依靠谁人处世度日呢？”

en.t: If I leave this daughter here alone, on whom can I have her depend as she makes her way through life?"

units.source_text: 他所忧虑的只是三公主之事。

en.t: The only thing that troubled him was the matter of the Third Princess.

units.source_text: 他在西山营造寺院，今已竣工，现正忙于入寺的种种准备。

en.t: He had built a temple in the western hills, and now that it was completed, he was busy with the many preparations for entering it.

units.source_text: 一方面又忙于准备三公主的着裳式。

en.t: At the same time, he was also busy preparing the Third Princess's mogi coming-of-age ceremony.

units.source_text: 院内秘藏的珍宝和器物，自不必说；连小小的玩具等，凡是略有来历之物，悉数赐与三公主。

en.t: It goes without saying that he gave her the precious treasures and vessels kept secretly in his palace; even small toys and the like, if they had any noteworthy history, were all bestowed on the Third Princess.

units.source_text: 其余次等物品，则由其他诸子女分得。

en.t: The remaining, lesser items were divided among his other children.
